# D05 数列极限的唯一性

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D05Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("数列极限的唯一性", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D05_1_1", "一个收敛数列不能同时趋近两个不同的数。我们将用定义中的任意小误差证明这一点。", "", tts_text="一个收敛数列不能同时趋近两个不同的数。我们将用定义中的任意小误差证明这一点。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"a_n\to A,\quad a_n\to B\Rightarrow A=B", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D05_1_1")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D05Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("数列极限的唯一性", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D05_2_1", "假设 A 不等于 B，两点距离为正，取误差为距离的三分之一。这样两个误差邻域不会相交。", "", tts_text="假设 A 不等于 B，两点距离为正，取误差为距离的三分之一。这样两个误差邻域不会相交。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"\varepsilon=\frac{|A-B|}{3}>0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D05_2_1")
        self.start_cue("D05_2_2", "由两个极限的定义，分别存在阈值 N 一和 N 二。", "", tts_text="由两个极限的定义，分别存在阈值 N 一和 N 二。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"n>N_1\Rightarrow |a_n-A|<\varepsilon", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D05_2_2")
        self.start_cue("D05_2_3", "对于第二个极限，同样有后续项与 B 的距离小于误差。", "", tts_text="对于第二个极限，同样有后续项与 B 的距离小于误差。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"n>N_2\Rightarrow |a_n-B|<\varepsilon", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("D05_2_3")
        self.start_cue("D05_2_4", "取 n 大于两个阈值的最大值，三角不等式推出 A 与 B 的距离小于其三分之二，矛盾。", "", tts_text="取 n 大于两个阈值的最大值，三角不等式推出 A 与 B 的距离小于其三分之二，矛盾。")
        self.play(FadeOut(line_1), FadeOut(line_2), FadeOut(line_3), run_time=min(0.35, self.cue_time_left()*0.15))
        line_4 = MathTex(r"|A-B|\le |A-a_n|+|a_n-B|<\frac23|A-B|", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_4, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_4), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_2_4", heading=heading, line1=line_4)
        self.end_cue("D05_2_4")
        self.start_cue("D05_2_5", "所以假设不成立，A 必须等于 B。", "", tts_text="所以假设不成立，A 必须等于 B。")
        line_5 = MathTex(r"A=B", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_5.next_to(line_4, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_5), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_2_5", heading=heading, line1=line_4, line2=line_5)
        self.end_cue("D05_2_5")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D05Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("数列极限的唯一性", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D05_3_1", "例题：已知 a n 的极限是三，能否还有另一个极限四？", "", tts_text="例题：已知 a n 的极限是三，能否还有另一个极限四？")
        line_1 = Text("已知极限为 3，能否同时为 4？", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D05_3_1")
        self.start_cue("D05_3_2", "由唯一性，两者必须相等，但三不等于四，因此不可能。", "", tts_text="由唯一性，两者必须相等，但三不等于四，因此不可能。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"3\ne4", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("D05_3_2")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class D05Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("数列极限的唯一性", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("D05_4_1", "证明思想：假设两个极限不同，用两个定义与共同阈值制造矛盾。唯一性只讨论已经存在的极限。", "", tts_text="证明思想：假设两个极限不同，用两个定义与共同阈值制造矛盾。唯一性只讨论已经存在的极限。")
        line_1 = Text("反证法、共同阈值、三角不等式", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("D05_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("D05_4_1")
```
